wl.exportdialog.title: Export captures
wl.exportdialog.description: Choose what to export and in which format. The file downloads when the server is ready.
wl.exportdialog.scope.tooMany: At most {{max}} captures can be exported together. Select fewer.
wl.exportdialog.format.csv.hint: One row per capture, summary columns
wl.exportdialog.format.zip.hint: One folder per capture with the raw body
wl.exportdialog.running: Preparing the export. Large exports can take a while.
wl.exportdialog.started: The download started. Your browser shows its progress.
wl.exportdialog.failed.busy: Another export is running for this endpoint. Try again in {{seconds}} s.
wl.exportdialog.failed.tooLarge: The selection is too large to export. Select fewer captures.
wl.exportdialog.failed.gone: This endpoint no longer exists or you no longer have access to it.
